current_open.description: Current number of open HTTP connections for the node.

total_opened.description: Total number of HTTP connections opened for the node.

clients.description:
Information on current and recently-closed HTTP client connections.
Clients that have been closed longer than the `http.client_stats.closed_channels.max_age` setting will not be represented here.

routes.description: Detailed HTTP stats broken down by route

id.description: Unique ID for the HTTP client.

agent.description:
Reported agent for the HTTP client.
If unavailable, this property is not included in the response.

local_address.description: Local address for the HTTP connection.

remote_address.description: Remote address for the HTTP connection.

last_uri.description: The URI of the client’s most recent request.

opened_time.description: Time at which the client opened the connection.

opened_time_millis.description: Time at which the client opened the connection.

closed_time.description: Time at which the client closed the connection if the connection is closed.

closed_time_millis.description: Time at which the client closed the connection if the connection is closed.

last_request_time.description: Time of the most recent request from this client.

last_request_time_millis.description: Time of the most recent request from this client.

request_count.description: Number of requests from this client.

request_size_bytes.description: Cumulative size in bytes of all requests from this client.

x_opaque_id.description:
Value from the client’s `x-opaque-id` HTTP header.
If unavailable, this property is not included in the response.

pipelines.description: Contains statistics about ingest pipelines for the node.

total.description: Contains statistics about ingest operations for the node.

count.description: Total number of documents ingested during the lifetime of this node.

current.description: Total number of documents currently being ingested.

failed.description: Total number of failed ingest operations during the lifetime of this node.

time.description: Total time spent preprocessing ingest documents during the lifetime of this node.

time_in_millis.description: Total time, in milliseconds, spent preprocessing ingest documents during the lifetime of this node.

ingested_as_first_pipeline.description:
Total size of all documents ingested by the pipeline.
The value counts documents for which this pipeline was the first to process them; for pipelines that are not the first to process a document (for example, a final pipeline after a default pipeline, a pipeline run after a reroute processor, or a pipeline invoked by a pipeline processor), the value is `0`.

ingested_as_first_pipeline_in_bytes.description:
Total number of bytes of all documents ingested by the pipeline.
The value counts documents for which this pipeline was the first to process them; for pipelines that are not the first to process a document, the value is `0`.

produced_as_first_pipeline.description:
Total size of all documents produced by the pipeline.
The value counts documents for which this pipeline was the first to process them; for pipelines that are not the first to process a document, the value is `0`.
In situations where there are subsequent pipelines, the value represents the size of the document after all pipelines have run.

produced_as_first_pipeline_in_bytes.description:
Total number of bytes of all documents produced by the pipeline.
The value counts documents for which this pipeline was the first to process them; for pipelines that are not the first to process a document, the value is `0`.
In situations where there are subsequent pipelines, the value represents the size of the document after all pipelines have run.

count.description: Number of documents transformed by the processor.

current.description: Number of documents currently being transformed by the processor.

failed.description: Number of failed operations for the processor.

time.description: Time spent by the processor transforming documents.

time_in_millis.description: Time, in milliseconds, spent by the processor transforming documents.

count.description: Total number of documents ingested during the lifetime of this node.

current.description: Total number of documents currently being ingested.

failed.description: Total number of failed ingest operations during the lifetime of this node.

time.description: Total time spent preprocessing ingest documents during the lifetime of this node.

time_in_millis.description: Total time, in milliseconds, spent preprocessing ingest documents during the lifetime of this node.

active.description: Number of active threads in the thread pool.

completed.description: Number of tasks completed by the thread pool executor.

largest.description: Highest number of active threads in the thread pool.

queue.description: Number of tasks in queue for the thread pool.

rejected.description: Number of tasks rejected by the thread pool executor.

threads.description: Number of threads in the thread pool.

cache_evictions.description: Total number of times the script cache has evicted old data.

compilations.description: Total number of inline script compilations performed by the node.

compilations_history.description: Contains this recent history of script compilations.

compilation_limit_triggered.description: Total number of times the script compilation circuit breaker has limited inline script compilations.

limit.description:
Configured memory limit for the indexing requests.
Replica requests have an automatic limit that is 1.5x this value.

limit_in_bytes.description:
Configured memory limit, in bytes, for the indexing requests.
Replica requests have an automatic limit that is 1.5x this value.

current.description: Contains statistics for current indexing load.

total.description: Contains statistics for the cumulative indexing load since the node started.

all.description: Memory consumed by indexing requests in the coordinating, primary, or replica stage.

all_in_bytes.description: Memory consumed, in bytes, by indexing requests in the coordinating, primary, or replica stage.

combined_coordinating_and_primary.description:
Memory consumed by indexing requests in the coordinating or primary stage.
This value is not the sum of coordinating and primary as a node can reuse the coordinating memory if the primary stage is executed locally.

combined_coordinating_and_primary_in_byt.description:
Memory consumed, in bytes, by indexing requests in the coordinating or primary stage.
This value is not the sum of coordinating and primary as a node can reuse the coordinating memory if the primary stage is executed locally.

coordinating.description: Memory consumed by indexing requests in the coordinating stage.

coordinating_in_bytes.description: Memory consumed, in bytes, by indexing requests in the coordinating stage.

primary.description: Memory consumed by indexing requests in the primary stage.

primary_in_bytes.description: Memory consumed, in bytes, by indexing requests in the primary stage.

replica.description: Memory consumed by indexing requests in the replica stage.

replica_in_bytes.description: Memory consumed, in bytes, by indexing requests in the replica stage.

coordinating_rejections.description: Number of indexing requests rejected in the coordinating stage.

primary_rejections.description: Number of indexing requests rejected in the primary stage.

replica_rejections.description: Number of indexing requests rejected in the replica stage.

repository_location.description: Represents an unique location within the repository.

repository_ephemeral_id.description: An identifier that changes every time the repository is updated.

repository_started_at.description: Time the repository was created or updated. Recorded in milliseconds since the Unix Epoch.

repository_stopped_at.description: Time the repository was deleted or updated. Recorded in milliseconds since the Unix Epoch.

archived.description:
A flag that tells whether or not this object has been archived. When a repository is closed or updated the
repository metering information is archived and kept for a certain period of time. This allows retrieving the
repository metering information of previous repository instantiations.

cluster_version.description:
The cluster state version when this object was archived, this field can be used as a logical timestamp to delete
all the archived metrics up to an observed version. This field is only present for archived repository metering
information objects. The main purpose of this field is to avoid possible race conditions during repository metering
information deletions, i.e. deleting archived repositories metering information that we haven’t observed yet.

request_counts.description: An object with the number of request performed against the repository grouped by request type.

GetBlobProperties.description: Number of Get Blob Properties requests (Azure)

PutBlockList.description: Number of Put Block List requests

GetObject.description: Number of get object requests (GCP, S3)

ListObjects.description: Number of list objects requests (GCP, S3)

InsertObject.description:
Number of insert object requests, including simple, multipart and resumable uploads. Resumable uploads
can perform multiple http requests to insert a single object but they are considered as a single request
since they are billed as an individual operation. (GCP)

PutMultipartObject.description: Number of Multipart requests, including CreateMultipartUpload, UploadPart and CompleteMultipartUpload requests (S3)

secure_setting_names.description: The names of the secure settings that were reloaded.

keystore_path.description: The path to the keystore file.

keystore_digest.description: A SHA-256 hash of the keystore file contents.

keystore_last_modified_time.description: The last modification time of the keystore file.

allocations.description: Statistics about shard allocations on the node.

breakers.description: Statistics about the field data circuit breaker.

fs.description: File system information, data path, free disk space, read/write stats.

host.description: Network host for the node, based on the network host setting.

ip.description: IP address and port for the node.

jvm.description: JVM stats, memory pool information, garbage collection, buffer pools, number of loaded/unloaded classes.

name.description:
Human-readable identifier for the node.
Based on the node name setting.

os.description: Operating system stats, load average, mem, swap.

process.description: Process statistics, memory consumption, cpu usage, open file descriptors.

script.description: Contains script statistics for the node.

thread_pool.description: Statistics about each thread pool, including current size, queue and rejected tasks.

transport.description: Transport statistics about sent and received bytes in cluster communication.

transport_address.description: Host and port for the transport layer, used for internal communication between nodes in a cluster.

attributes.description: Contains a list of attributes for the node.

discovery.description: Contains node discovery statistics for the node.

indexing_pressure.description: Contains indexing pressure statistics for the node.

indices.description: Indices stats about size, document count, indexing and deletion times, search times, field cache size, merges and flushes.

repositories.description: Statistics about snapshot activity for the node's registered repositories, keyed by repository name.

avg_queue_size.description: The exponentially weighted moving average queue size of search requests on the keyed node.

avg_response_time.description: The exponentially weighted moving average response time of search requests on the keyed node.

avg_response_time_ns.description: The exponentially weighted moving average response time, in nanoseconds, of search requests on the keyed node.

avg_service_time.description: The exponentially weighted moving average service time of search requests on the keyed node.

avg_service_time_ns.description: The exponentially weighted moving average service time, in nanoseconds, of search requests on the keyed node.

outgoing_searches.description: The number of outstanding search requests to the keyed node from the node these stats are for.

rank.description: The rank of this node; used for shard selection when routing search requests.

shards.description: Number of shards allocated to the node.

undesired_shards.description: Number of shards allocated to the node that are currently undesired.

forecasted_ingest_load.description: Forecasted ingest load for the node.

forecasted_disk_usage.description: Forecasted disk usage for the node.

forecasted_disk_usage_in_bytes.description: Forecasted disk usage, in bytes, for the node.

current_disk_usage.description: Current disk usage for the node.

current_disk_usage_in_bytes.description: Current disk usage, in bytes, for the node.

estimated_size.description: Estimated memory used for the operation.

estimated_size_in_bytes.description: Estimated memory used, in bytes, for the operation.

limit_size.description: Memory limit for the circuit breaker.

limit_size_in_bytes.description: Memory limit, in bytes, for the circuit breaker.

overhead.description: A constant that all estimates for the circuit breaker are multiplied with to calculate a final estimate.

tripped.description: Total number of times the circuit breaker has been triggered and prevented an out of memory error.

timestamp.description:
Last time the file stores statistics were refreshed.
Recorded in milliseconds since the Unix Epoch.

total.description: Contains statistics for all file stores of the node.

io_stats.description: Contains I/O statistics for the node.

available.description: Total amount of disk space available to this Java virtual machine on this file store.

available_in_bytes.description: Total number of bytes available to this Java virtual machine on this file store.

free.description: Total amount of unallocated disk space in the file store.

free_in_bytes.description: Total number of unallocated bytes in the file store.

low_watermark_free_space.description: The amount of free disk space that, once reached, triggers the low disk watermark.

low_watermark_free_space_in_bytes.description: The amount of free disk space, in bytes, that, once reached, triggers the low disk watermark.

high_watermark_free_space.description: The amount of free disk space that, once reached, triggers the high disk watermark.

high_watermark_free_space_in_bytes.description: The amount of free disk space, in bytes, that, once reached, triggers the high disk watermark.

flood_stage_free_space.description: The amount of free disk space that, once reached, triggers the flood stage disk watermark.

flood_stage_free_space_in_bytes.description: The amount of free disk space, in bytes, that, once reached, triggers the flood stage disk watermark.

frozen_flood_stage_free_space.description: The amount of free disk space that, once reached, triggers the frozen flood stage disk watermark.

frozen_flood_stage_free_space_in_bytes.description: The amount of free disk space, in bytes, that, once reached, triggers the frozen flood stage disk watermark.

mount.description: Mount point of the file store (for example: `/dev/sda2`).

total.description: Total size of the file store.

total_in_bytes.description: Total size of the file store in bytes.

type.description: Type of the file store (ex: ext4).

available.description:
Total disk space available to this Java virtual machine on all file stores.
Depending on OS or process level restrictions, this might appear less than `free`.
This is the actual amount of free disk space the Elasticsearch node can utilise.

available_in_bytes.description:
Total number of bytes available to this Java virtual machine on all file stores.
Depending on OS or process level restrictions, this might appear less than `free_in_bytes`.
This is the actual amount of free disk space the Elasticsearch node can utilise.

free.description: Total unallocated disk space in all file stores.

free_in_bytes.description: Total number of unallocated bytes in all file stores.

total.description: Total size of all file stores.

total_in_bytes.description: Total size of all file stores in bytes.

Array of disk metrics for each device that is backing an Elasticsearch data path.
These disk metrics are probed periodically and averages between the last probe and the current probe are computed.

operations.description: The total number of read and write operations for the device completed since starting Elasticsearch.

read_kilobytes.description: The total number of kilobytes read for the device since starting Elasticsearch.

read_operations.description: The total number of read operations for the device completed since starting Elasticsearch.

write_kilobytes.description: The total number of kilobytes written for the device since starting Elasticsearch.

write_operations.description: The total number of write operations for the device completed since starting Elasticsearch.

classes.description: Contains statistics about classes loaded by JVM for the node.

gc.description: Contains statistics about JVM garbage collectors for the node.

mem.description: Contains JVM memory usage statistics for the node.

threads.description: Contains statistics about JVM thread usage for the node.

uptime.description:

heap_committed_in_bytes.description: Amount of memory, in bytes, available for use by the heap.

heap_max_in_bytes.description: Maximum amount of memory, in bytes, available for use by the heap.

non_heap_committed_in_bytes.description: Amount of non-heap memory available, in bytes.

pools.description: Contains statistics about heap memory usage for the node.

used_in_bytes.description: Memory, in bytes, used by the heap.

max.description: Maximum amount of memory available for use by the heap.

max_in_bytes.description: Maximum amount of memory, in bytes, available for use by the heap.

peak_used.description: Largest amount of memory historically used by the heap.

peak_used_in_bytes.description: Largest amount of memory, in bytes, historically used by the heap.

peak_max.description: Largest amount of memory historically used by the heap.

peak_max_in_bytes.description: Largest amount of memory, in bytes, historically used by the heap.

count.description: Number of active threads in use by JVM.

peak_count.description: Highest number of threads used by JVM.

available_processors.description: The number of processors available to the Java virtual machine.

adjusted_total.description:
If the amount of physical memory has been overridden using the `es`.`total_memory_bytes` system property then this reports the overridden value.
Otherwise it reports the same value as `total`.

adjusted_total_in_bytes.description:
If the amount of physical memory has been overridden using the `es`.`total_memory_bytes` system property then this reports the overridden value in bytes.

total_in_bytes.description: Total amount of physical memory in bytes.

free_in_bytes.description: Amount of free physical memory in bytes.

used_in_bytes.description: Amount of used physical memory in bytes.

adjusted_total.description:
If the amount of physical memory has been overridden using the `es`.`total_memory_bytes` system property then this reports the overridden value.
Otherwise it reports the same value as `total`.

adjusted_total_in_bytes.description:
If the amount of physical memory has been overridden using the `es`.`total_memory_bytes` system property then this reports the overridden value in bytes.
Otherwise it reports the same value as `total_in_bytes`.

total_in_bytes.description: Total amount of physical memory in bytes.

free_in_bytes.description: Amount of free physical memory in bytes.

used_in_bytes.description: Amount of used physical memory in bytes.

cpuacct.description: Contains statistics about `cpuacct` control group for the node.

cpu.description: Contains statistics about `cpu` control group for the node.

memory.description: Contains statistics about the memory control group for the node.

control_group.description: The `cpuacct` control group to which the Elasticsearch process belongs.

usage_nanos.description: The total CPU time, in nanoseconds, consumed by all tasks in the same cgroup as the Elasticsearch process.

control_group.description: The `cpu` control group to which the Elasticsearch process belongs.

cfs_period_micros.description: The period of time, in microseconds, for how regularly all tasks in the same cgroup as the Elasticsearch process should have their access to CPU resources reallocated.

cfs_quota_micros.description: The total amount of time, in microseconds, for which all tasks in the same cgroup as the Elasticsearch process can run during one period `cfs_period_micros`.

stat.description: Contains CPU statistics for the node.

number_of_elapsed_periods.description: The number of reporting periods (as specified by `cfs_period_micros`) that have elapsed.

number_of_times_throttled.description: The number of times all tasks in the same cgroup as the Elasticsearch process have been throttled.

time_throttled_nanos.description: The total amount of time, in nanoseconds, for which all tasks in the same cgroup as the Elasticsearch process have been throttled.

control_group.description: The `memory` control group to which the Elasticsearch process belongs.

limit_in_bytes.description:
The maximum amount of user memory (including file cache) allowed for all tasks in the same cgroup as the Elasticsearch process.
This value can be too big to store in a `long`, so is returned as a string so that the value returned can exactly match what the underlying operating system interface returns.
Any value that is too large to parse into a `long` almost certainly means no limit has been set for the cgroup.

usage_in_bytes.description:
The total current memory usage by processes in the cgroup, in bytes, by all tasks in the same cgroup as the Elasticsearch process.
This value is stored as a string for consistency with `limit_in_bytes`.

cpu.description: Contains CPU statistics for the node.

mem.description: Contains virtual memory statistics for the node.

open_file_descriptors.description: Number of opened file descriptors associated with the current or `-1` if not supported.

max_file_descriptors.description: Maximum number of file descriptors allowed on the system, or `-1` if not supported.

timestamp.description:
Last time the statistics were refreshed.
Recorded in milliseconds since the Unix Epoch.

cache_evictions.description: Total number of times the script cache has evicted old data.

compilation_limit_triggered.description: Total number of times the script compilation circuit breaker has limited inline script compilations.

compilations.description: Total number of inline script compilations performed by the node.

inbound_handling_time_histogram.description: The distribution of the time spent handling each inbound message on a transport thread, represented as a histogram.

outbound_handling_time_histogram.description: The distribution of the time spent sending each outbound transport message on a transport thread, represented as a histogram.

rx_count.description: Total number of RX (receive) packets received by the node during internal cluster communication.

rx_size.description: Size of RX packets received by the node during internal cluster communication.

rx_size_in_bytes.description: Size, in bytes, of RX packets received by the node during internal cluster communication.

server_open.description: Current number of inbound TCP connections used for internal communication between nodes.

tx_count.description: Total number of TX (transmit) packets sent by the node during internal cluster communication.

tx_size.description: Size of TX packets sent by the node during internal cluster communication.

tx_size_in_bytes.description: Size, in bytes, of TX packets sent by the node during internal cluster communication.

total_outbound_connections.description:
The cumulative number of outbound transport connections that this node has opened since it started.
Each transport connection may comprise multiple TCP connections but is only counted once in this statistic.
Transport connections are typically long-lived so this statistic should remain constant in a stable cluster.

actions.description: Statistics about the transport messages sent and received by the node, broken down by action name.

count.description: The number of times a transport thread took a period of time within the bounds of this bucket to handle an inbound message.

lt.description:
The exclusive upper bound of the bucket.
May be omitted on the last bucket if this bucket has no upper bound.

lt_millis.description:
The exclusive upper bound of the bucket in milliseconds.
May be omitted on the last bucket if this bucket has no upper bound.

ge.description: The inclusive lower bound of the bucket. May be omitted on the first bucket if this bucket has no lower bound.

ge_millis.description: The inclusive lower bound of the bucket in milliseconds. May be omitted on the first bucket if this bucket has no lower bound.

requests.description: Statistics about the requests received for this action.

responses.description: Statistics about the responses sent for this action.

count.description: The number of messages of this kind that the node has handled for this action.

total_size.description: The cumulative size of the messages of this kind that the node has handled for this action.

total_size_in_bytes.description: The cumulative size, in bytes, of the messages of this kind that the node has handled for this action.

histogram.description: The distribution of the sizes of the messages of this kind that the node has handled for this action, represented as a histogram.

count.description: The number of messages with a size that falls within the bounds of this bucket.

ge.description:
The inclusive lower bound of the bucket.
May be omitted on the first bucket if this bucket has no lower bound.

ge_bytes.description:
The inclusive lower bound of the bucket in bytes.
May be omitted on the first bucket if this bucket has no lower bound.

lt.description:
The exclusive upper bound of the bucket.
May be omitted on the last bucket if this bucket has no upper bound.

lt_bytes.description:
The exclusive upper bound of the bucket in bytes.
May be omitted on the last bucket if this bucket has no upper bound.

cluster_state_queue.description: Contains statistics for the cluster state queue of the node.

published_cluster_states.description: Contains statistics for the published cluster states of the node.

cluster_state_update.description:
Contains low-level statistics about how long various activities took during cluster state updates while the node was the elected master.
Omitted if the node is not master-eligible.
Every field whose name ends in `_time` within this object is also represented as a raw number of milliseconds in a field whose name ends in `_time_millis`.
The human-readable fields with a `_time` suffix are only returned if requested with the `?human=true` query parameter.

total.description: Total number of cluster states in queue.

pending.description: Number of pending cluster states in queue.

committed.description: Number of committed cluster states in queue.

incompatible_diffs.description: Number of incompatible differences between published cluster states.

compatible_diffs.description: Number of compatible differences between published cluster states.

count.description: The number of cluster state update attempts that did not change the cluster state since the node started.

computation_time.description: The cumulative amount of time spent computing no-op cluster state updates since the node started.

computation_time_millis.description: The cumulative amount of time, in milliseconds, spent computing no-op cluster state updates since the node started.

publication_time.description:
The cumulative amount of time spent publishing cluster state updates which ultimately succeeded, which includes everything from the start of the publication (just after the computation of the new cluster state) until the publication has finished and the master node is ready to start processing the next state update.
This includes the time measured by `context_construction_time`, `commit_time`, `completion_time` and `master_apply_time`.

publication_time_millis.description:
The cumulative amount of time, in milliseconds, spent publishing cluster state updates which ultimately succeeded, which includes everything from the start of the publication (just after the computation of the new cluster state) until the publication has finished and the master node is ready to start processing the next state update.
This includes the time measured by `context_construction_time`, `commit_time`, `completion_time` and `master_apply_time`.

context_construction_time.description:
The cumulative amount of time spent constructing a publication context since the node started for publications that ultimately succeeded.
This statistic includes the time spent computing the difference between the current and new cluster state preparing a serialized representation of this difference.

context_construction_time_millis.description:
The cumulative amount of time, in milliseconds, spent constructing a publication context since the node started for publications that ultimately succeeded.
This statistic includes the time spent computing the difference between the current and new cluster state preparing a serialized representation of this difference.

commit_time.description: The cumulative amount of time spent waiting for a successful cluster state update to commit, which measures the time from the start of each publication until a majority of the master-eligible nodes have written the state to disk and confirmed the write to the elected master.

commit_time_millis.description: The cumulative amount of time, in milliseconds, spent waiting for a successful cluster state update to commit, which measures the time from the start of each publication until a majority of the master-eligible nodes have written the state to disk and confirmed the write to the elected master.

completion_time.description: The cumulative amount of time spent waiting for a successful cluster state update to complete, which measures the time from the start of each publication until all the other nodes have notified the elected master that they have applied the cluster state.

completion_time_millis.description: The cumulative amount of time, in milliseconds,  spent waiting for a successful cluster state update to complete, which measures the time from the start of each publication until all the other nodes have notified the elected master that they have applied the cluster state.

master_apply_time.description: The cumulative amount of time spent successfully applying cluster state updates on the elected master since the node started.

master_apply_time_millis.description: The cumulative amount of time, in milliseconds, spent successfully applying cluster state updates on the elected master since the node started.

notification_time.description: The cumulative amount of time spent notifying listeners of a no-op cluster state update since the node started.

notification_time_millis.description: The cumulative amount of time, in milliseconds, spent notifying listeners of a no-op cluster state update since the node started.

memory.description: Contains statistics for memory consumption from indexing load.

total_read_throttled_time.description: The cumulative time spent throttling read operations for this repository.

total_write_throttled_time.description: The cumulative time spent throttling write operations for this repository.

total_read_throttled_time_nanos.description: The cumulative time, in nanoseconds, spent throttling read operations for this repository.

total_write_throttled_time_nanos.description: The cumulative time, in nanoseconds, spent throttling write operations for this repository.

shard_snapshots_started.description: The number of shard snapshots started for this repository.

shard_snapshots_completed.description: The number of shard snapshots completed for this repository.

shard_snapshots_in_progress.description: The number of shard snapshots currently in progress for this repository.

uploaded_blobs.description: The number of blobs uploaded to this repository.

uploaded_size.description: The cumulative size of the blobs uploaded to this repository.

uploaded_size_in_bytes.description: The cumulative size, in bytes, of the blobs uploaded to this repository.

total_upload_time.description: The cumulative time spent uploading blobs to this repository.

total_upload_time_in_millis.description: The cumulative time, in milliseconds, spent uploading blobs to this repository.

total_read_time.description: The cumulative time spent reading blobs while uploading to this repository.

total_read_time_in_millis.description: The cumulative time, in milliseconds, spent reading blobs while uploading to this repository.
